subject.title: fix(brave): forward the execution abort signal to web search HTTP requests

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 own the shared abort-terminal fallback guard, with this PR rebased to retain only its unique Brave changes?
rationale: Several open provider PRs contain the same shared-runtime hunk, and repository history does not establish which contributor branch should own that common invariant.

options.title: Use the proof-positive shared fix
options.body: Land the shared fallback guard through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 and rebase this PR around the resulting current main.

options.title: Use this PR as shared owner
options.body: Land the shared guard here and require every sibling provider PR to remove its duplicate runtime hunk before merge.

recommendation.title: Use the proof-positive shared fix
recommendation.body: Land the shared fallback guard through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 and rebase this PR around the resulting current main.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared runtime and its major provider-routing refactors are most strongly connected to this person’s current-main history.
